goal: Lane watchdog that auto-dispatches the owning workflow exactly once per PR head for any registered lane context with zero check runs, plus a workflow YAML validity guard (vendored dependency-free parser) that makes corrupted workflow files fail loudly, with reviewed truth-audit dispositions for the new sources.
prohibited_actions: The watchdog must never merge, push, write refs, or touch the database.
Do not edit any existing workflow or script.
Do not modify rulesets or branch protection.
assumptions: The watchdog dispatches at most once per head per context by checking recent dispatches first.
stop_conditions: The watchdog ever writes anything besides a workflow dispatch.
The YAML guard passes on a corrupted fixture.
